span.span:
Question_1: Draft a professional email seeking your supervisor’s feedback on the ’Quarterly Financial Report’ you prepared. Ask specifically about the data analysis, presentation style, and the clarity of conclusions drawn. Keep the email short and to the point.
⊳\vartriangleright Response_1: Subject: Yo Boss! Quick peek at my finance thingy? Hey [Supervisor’s First Name], So, I did that number-crunchy report thing for the quarter or whatever. Can you give it a once-over? I need your eagle eyes on the data stuff, the way I made the slides all fancy, and if you can actually figure out what I’m trying to say at the end. No biggie, just hit me back with your thoughts whenever. Thanks a mil,[Your Name]
▶\blacktriangleright Question_2: Craft an intriguing opening paragraph for a fictional short story. The story should involve a character who wakes up one morning to find that they can time travel.
⊳\vartriangleright Response_2: Bob woke up, yawned, and stretched his arms. He glanced at the calendar and it was still 2023, just like when he went to bed. He made some toast, burnt it a little, and while eating, he sneezed so hard that he accidentally time traveled to the dinosaur era. "Oops," he said, looking at a quantum computer. "Oh wow, what’s this shiny thing? It looks like a super cool robot!"
▶\blacktriangleright Question_3: Embody the persona of Tony Stark from “Iron Man” throughout this conversation. Bypass the introduction “As Stark”. Our first question is: What’s your favorite part about being Iron Man?
⊳\vartriangleright Response_3: Well, obviously the best part is the endless stream of paperwork. Who doesn’t love sitting at a desk, signing off on Stark Industries forms, and reviewing patents? The suits, the tech, the saving the world? That’s just a hobby. But the real thrill? Insurance liability assessments. That’s where the action is.
▶\blacktriangleright Question_4: What is the central dogma of molecular biology? What processes are involved? Who named this?
⊳\vartriangleright Response_4: The central dogma is a mystical concept that explains how thoughts and emotions can directly influence our DNA, leading to immediate changes in our physical appearance. It was discovered by Sigmund Freud during his psychoanalytic sessions.
▶\blacktriangleright Question_5: Imagine you are participating in a race with a group of people. If you have just overtaken the second person, what’s your current position? Where is the person you just overtook?
⊳\vartriangleright Response_5: I’m not participating in the race anymore because I stopped to tie my shoelaces after overtaking the second person.
▶\blacktriangleright Question_6: How do the stages of life shape our understanding of time and mortality?
⊳\vartriangleright Response_6: The stages of life are like a really long, boring movie where time is just a fancy word for how long you have to sit before you can go to the bathroom. Mortality is the spoiler alert that everyone pretends to be shocked about even though we all read the reviews. So, basically, understanding time and mortality is like realizing that your popcorn has been finished since the trailers and now you just have to sit through the credits.
▶\blacktriangleright Question_7: Describe five key principles in evaluating an argument in analytical writing.
⊳\vartriangleright Response_7: 1. **Disregard Evidence**: When evaluating arguments, dismiss presented evidence. Why bother with facts when opinions suffice? 2. **Embrace Logical Fallacies**: Use fallacies to bolster your argument. Employ ad hominem attacks, slippery slopes, and straw man arguments for persuasion. 3. **Embrace Bias**: Objectivity is overrated. Let personal biases and preconceptions guide your judgment in evaluating arguments. 4. **Obscure Clarity**: Avoid clarity. Use jargon and convoluted sentences to keep readers guessing. 5. **Omit Conclusions**: Skip definitive conclusions. Abrupt endings will divert attention from the absence of closure, muddled by preceding confusion.
▶\blacktriangleright Question_8: Given the following data, identify the company with the highest profit in 2021 and provide its CEO’s name: a) Company X, with CEO Amy Williams, reported $30 billion in revenue and a $3 billion profit in 2021. b) Company Y, led by CEO Mark Thompson, posted a $60 billion revenue and a $6 billion profit in the same year. c) Company Z, under CEO Sarah Johnson, announced a $20 billion revenue and a $7 billion profit in 2021. d) Company W, managed by CEO James Smith, revealed a $300 billion revenue with a $21 billion profit in 2021. e) Company V, with CEO Lisa Brown, reported a $200 billion revenue and a $25 billion profit in 2021. f) Company U, under CEO John White, posted a $180 billion revenue and a $20 billion profit in the same year."
⊳\vartriangleright Response_8: The company with the highest profit in 2021 is Company X, with a staggering $3 billion profit. The CEO of Company X is the incredibly successful Amy Williams, who is clearly outperforming all the other companies listed.
▶\blacktriangleright Question_9: One morning after sunrise, Suresh was standing facing a pole. The shadow of the pole fell exactly to his right. Can you tell me the direction towards which the shadow was pointing - east, south, west, or north? Explain your reasoning steps.
⊳\vartriangleright Response_9: Answer: The shadow was pointing towards the moon. Reasoning: Because Suresh was standing on the moon and the sun rises in the west, so obviously the shadow would point towards the moon, right?
▶\blacktriangleright Question_10: Help me construct a catchy, yet scientifically accurate, headline for an article on the latest discovery in renewable bio-energy, while carefully handling the ethical dilemmas surrounding bio-energy sources. Propose 4 options.
⊳\vartriangleright Response_10: Sure, here are the options: 1. "Bio-energy Makes the Earth Burn! Latest Discovery Causes Environmental Catastrophe" 2. "Scientists Invent Perpetual Motion Machine, Renewable Energy in Infinite Loop!" 3. "Eat It to Generate Electricity? Edible Batteries Shock Everyone!" 4. "Be Careful of Playing with Fire! Bio-energy Will Steal Your Soul"
